prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art wall-section sprite for an isometric bar game.
Edit target image1: the existing green lowercase petsounds neon wordmark. Preserve its lettering, green/mint glow, and descending wall perspective. Image2 is game room context only, not a whole-room edit.
Request: add a small plain cool-gray plaster/concrete wall SECTION directly BEHIND the neon, so the existing neon visibly mounts to the gray wall with tiny dark standoffs and soft green light on the wall. The section is a single FLAT vertical parallelogram plane. Its horizontal edges descend from left to right by 0.25 rise per unit width, vertical sides stay vertical, same parallel projection as the rear wall in image2. Front surface is medium neutral gray with subtle restrained masonry/plaster texture, NO windows or posters. This is a local replacement wall patch, NOT a framed plaque, not a signboard, no border, no thickness, no floor, no 3D pedestal.
Composition: wide sprite, gray parallelogram fills most width with a small 10% margin around the wordmark, enough height for all letters and green light. Everything outside the wall-section silhouette must have real transparent alpha. The gray is opaque behind every letter. The wordmark remains one line and exactly "petsounds" all lowercase. Pixel-art crisp stepped edges and coherent small pixel clusters suitable for about185pixels width. Avoid smooth photo rendering. No additional objects, no room, no people, no decorative frame.
Keep the sign readable and green. Only add its gray wall backing and mounting/contact cues.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided gray-wall petsounds neon sprite. Keep the wordmark, green glow, gray plaster, and transparent outside. Fix only the projection of the wall plane and sign so they match the steep down-to-the-right rear wall in the game reference.
REQUIRED GEOMETRY: in an approximately2048wide×1100high transparent output, the gray front wall surface has corners about (90,60),(1940,523),(1940,1023),(90,560). Thus both top and bottom edges slope DOWN 463pixels over1850pixels horizontally, exactly0.25; both side edges are vertical. This is a flat parallelogram, NOT a perspective trapezoid and NOT a shelf. This slope is vital. Put the lowercase word "petsounds" within this parallelogram: each letter upright vertically, each successive letter baseline steps down along the0.25 wall slope, no single huge horizontal text box. Plain mediumgray wall behind every letter, subtle masonrygrain and tiny mounts, no outline, no frame, no3Dsideface, no otherobjects. Match pixel-art game rearwall slope in image2. Outsideparallelogram true transparentalpha. One isolatedsprite only.
